result.topic_en: Reduction of a ternary quadratic form in coordinates of points on the sphere to a sum of squares by an orthogonal substitution, leading to the cubic equation whose roots are the coefficients G, G', G''.
result.transcription:
Reduction der Function
$Axx + Byy + Czz + 2ayz + 2bxz + 2cxy$
wo $x,y,z$ Coordinaten unbestimmter Punkte der Kugelfl. bedeuten, auf
$GXX + G'X'X' + G''X''X''$
durch die Substitution
$x = \alpha X + \alpha' X' + \alpha'' X''$
$y = \beta X + \beta' X' + \beta'' X''$
$z = \gamma X + \gamma' X' + \gamma'' X''$
wo zwischen den Coëfficienten die bekannten Relationen Statt finden. Also
$X = \alpha x + \beta y + \gamma z$
$X' = \alpha' x + \beta' y + \gamma' z$
$X'' = \alpha'' x + \beta'' y + \gamma'' z$
Wir haben folglich
$A = G\alpha\alpha + G'\alpha'\alpha' + G''\alpha''\alpha''$
$B = G\beta\beta + G'\beta'\beta' + G''\beta''\beta''$
$C = G\gamma\gamma + G'\gamma'\gamma' + G''\gamma''\gamma''$
$a = G\beta\gamma + G'\beta'\gamma' + G''\beta''\gamma''$
$b = G\alpha\gamma + G'\alpha'\gamma' + G''\alpha''\gamma''$
$c = G\alpha\beta + G'\alpha'\beta' + G''\alpha''\beta''$
$\alpha A + \gamma b + \beta c = \alpha G$
$\beta B + \alpha c + \gamma a = \beta G$
$\gamma C + \beta a + \alpha b = \gamma G$
und
$\alpha(bc + a(G-A)) = \beta(ac + b(G-B)) = \gamma(ab + c(G-C))$ [-$= \partial$-][?]
$1 = \frac{bc}{bc + a(G-A)} + \frac{ac}{ac + b(G-B)} + \frac{ab}{ab + c(G-C)}$ *
$-2a[-b-]bc$[?]
$-$ [-$abc$-] $((aa+bb+cc)G - aaA - bbB - ccC)$
[-$+ bbcc(G-B)(G-C) + aacc(G-A)(G-C) + aabb(G-A)(G-B)$-] $\Big\} = 0$
$+$ [-$abc$-] $(G-A)(G-B)(G-C)$
Wurzeln dieser cubischen Gleichung sind $G, G', G''$
$(G-A)(G-B)(G-C) - aa(G-A) - bb(G-B) - cc(G-C) - 2abc = 0$

methods.what: Orthogonal substitution transforming a ternary quadratic form into a sum of squares (principal axes)
Inverse of the orthogonal substitution via transposed coefficients
Expression of the form coefficients in terms of eigenvalues and direction cosines
Eigenvector equations for the symmetric matrix
Characteristic cubic equation whose roots are the eigenvalues G, G', G''

items.quote: Wurzeln dieser cubischen Gleichung sind $G, G', G''$
items.english: The roots of this cubic equation are G, G', G''.
